title: Microsoft Entra ID security updates: Passkeys are the default authentication method in Entra ID
text: Microsoft Entra ID is making passkeys the default authentication method to combat the rising sophistication of identity attacks in the AI era. Starting September 1, 2026, users currently enabled for SMS or voice authentication will be prompted to register a passkey, and by February 1, 2027, Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication will be retired. Organizations needing these methods will be directed to third-party telecom providers through the Microsoft Security Store, with a strong recommendation to transition to phishing-resistant passkeys.
